project: FLAME-conditioned Avatar Forcing: region-masking ablations on Avatar Forcing crops
project_note: Every ablation branches from one shared 25k-step trunk (landmark-only, no masks) and trains with a masked-consistency loss: each sample also runs with part of the FLAME condition removed. Evaluation: HDTF-50 at the Avatar Forcing crop, in three modes (full FLAME, FLAME without mouth + jaw, audio only).

runs.name: flame_v3_abl2b_afcrop
runs.title: Ablation 2b
runs.description: As ablation 2, but the 75 % share removes a growing top fraction of one FLAME parameter's most-moving points: 10 % at 25k, +10 % every ~6.1k steps, all points from 80k. Mouth + jaw is removed on the other 25 %.

runs.name: flame_v3_abl4_afcrop
runs.title: Ablation 4
runs.description: Only the mouth + jaw is masked, on 25 % of samples; the other 75 % train unmasked.

runs.name: flame_v3_abl2_afcrop
runs.title: Ablation 2
runs.description: Masked consistency: mouth + jaw removed on 25 % of samples, otherwise the top-300 moving points of one of 55 FLAME parameters (expressions 1-50, jaw, eyelids).
runs.note: Stopped at 170k: the results were already strong.
